objective: Keep ActionResult execution evidence separate from observed WorldState spatial truth so only accepted Observation events may establish entity locations and entity-bound evidence used for task verification.
decision_supported: Can completed and non-completed ActionResult events remain durably replayable execution evidence without creating or replacing observed spatial facts, while an explicit post-action Observation remains the only path to confirmed placement?
acceptance: Every validated ACTION_RESULT remains represented in applied_event_ids and its evidence_refs remain in the global execution evidence stream.
ACTION_RESULT evidence is never added to entity_evidence_refs and is never relabelled or returned as Observation evidence supporting an entity location.
A completed ActionResult with entity_id and resulting_location does not create, replace or clear entity_locations, entity_confidence, entity_attributes or entity_evidence_refs.
A completed ActionResult without entity_id and resulting_location also leaves all observed entity state unchanged.
A failed, canceled, safe-stop or timeout ActionResult leaves all observed entity state unchanged while remaining replayable execution evidence.
A completed ActionResult claiming resulting_location without any accepted spatial Observation for that entity yields insufficient_evidence with target_not_observed and never confirmed.
A supporting Observation ordered after the ActionResult may establish the claimed location and yields confirmed using only the supporting Observation evidence reference.
A contradictory Observation ordered after the ActionResult establishes the observed contradictory location and yields refuted using only the contradictory Observation evidence reference.
An earlier accepted Observation remains unchanged when a later ActionResult is reduced; this Packet does not clear, overwrite or relabel previously observed facts.
Exact duplicate ACTION_RESULT delivery is idempotent and deterministic replay produces byte-equivalent WorldState for the same ordered unique event stream.
The scripted demo constructs an explicit post-action Observation whose camera evidence, not the ActionResult evidence, supports confirmed placement.
Removing only the post-action Observation from the scripted event list changes verification for the same run from confirmed to insufficient_evidence.

The scripted pre-action red-block event may establish identity, confidence and sensor evidence but does not establish the final in-tray spatial relation; only the post-action Observation establishes that relation.
General enforcement that every physical action requires a temporally newer Observation belongs to Issue #151 and is not implemented by changing verifier freshness semantics in this Packet.
No interface, shared contract, event-store schema, typed payload rule, Motion code, Agent Runtime code, robot-control code, firmware or safety configuration is modified.

risks_and_fallbacks: PR #257 and PR #258 are merged. Issue #150 is based directly on main commit c1d020bffa0dacb059aa51e2770c503ff1ec96d6 and its PR must target main; if main advances before submission, refresh the base and rerun every required check.
Issue #150 separates execution claims from observed truth but does not implement the general post-action freshness gate owned by Issue #151 or observation aging owned by Issue #165.

If an entity has an older contradictory Observation, preserving that observation means the current verifier may return refuted rather than insufficient_evidence. Do not hide this by clearing the observation; stop if the Owner requires different semantics in #150.

The scripted fixture will use a pre-action red-block Observation that does not establish the final spatial relation and a distinct post-action Observation that does. This proves evidence separation without modifying verifier freshness semantics.
The Python ActionResult entity_id and resulting_location fields remain absent from the public JSON Schema. This Packet neither changes nor claims to resolve that existing contract drift.
Updating tools/scripts/demo_scripted.py crosses the Integration review boundary. The PR must explicitly request Integration Owner review even when implementation proceeds under prior human approval.

The repository-local robot/control/.venv contains symbolic links that can obstruct existing Task Packet validation. Do not weaken Packet boundaries; only relocate and restore that environment if the user separately authorizes the operation.
